name: kazahana
description: Editorial blog theme with a masthead and topic strip, big EB Garamond headlines, hairline meta rows and a pine intro block, in snow white and camellia red.

show_intro.title: Intro block on the home page
show_intro.description: Show the pine block with the tagline, topics and the latest notes above the newest post.

drop_cap.title: Drop cap on posts
drop_cap.description: Start each post with a large red initial letter.

header_topics.title: Topics in the header
header_topics.description: Show the categories under the masthead, and as a strip on small screens.

header_dateline.title: Dateline in the header
header_dateline.description: Show the date of the latest note and the site tagline left of the site name.

color_mode.title: Colour mode
color_mode.description: What a first-time visitor sees. Visitors can still switch with the header toggle.
